rationale: The original short thesis relied on price remaining suppressed beneath the 5-minute 9-EMA ($227.56), which has now been decisively reclaimed as price surged through $229.12. Four consecutive bullish 1-minute candles on expanding volume show strong buying momentum pushing toward session VWAP ($230.23) and the $229.90 invalidation level. Exiting now cuts the loss on a broken technical setup rather than waiting for the hard stop to trigger in an environment where SPY is up over 5.3%.
